units: B’shall. 11 אומרין שהוא ר׳ וכ׳ they say (in praise of a man) that he is merciful, he (God) is more. Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 1 שהוא ר׳ ואינו וכ׳ they praise a king that he is kindhearted, yet he is cruel; Yalk. Ex. 242. Tanḥ. ʿEḳeb 2 נשר שהוא ר׳ על בניו the eagle which is full of love for its young; Yalk. Prov. 963; a. e.—Pl. רַחֲמָנִים, v. רַחֲמָן.—Fem. רַחֲמָנִית, v. רַחֲמָן.
